notes.title: First big update
notes.notes:
Hi! First of all, sorry for the delay, I'm only one dev.
I listen to you and I've been working on some improvements.
Now are floating windows that explain stats, icons etc...
The enemies now have indicator of what buff/debuffs are affecting them.
Some monster have been balanced.
I erased the guild scene, was useless, now the game goes right to the point.
Added rounds counter.
Improving of the layering and UI.
And a lot of minor fixes.
[previewyoutube=GdfavcgYfkw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope you like it!!
